text:
ada: FYI spotted duplicated SCIM identities for two customers after yesterday's KMS alias swap (idp-kms-main -> idp-kms-v2026). Not widespread but triggers audit failures.

devin: Duplicates = same email/displayName? Any 4xx/5xx in the provisioner logs?

ada: Exactly same email/displayName. One row has extId=jwe:oaep:v1:... the other jwe:oaep256:v2:... Provisioner flow shows a 409 then a fallback create. Paste log:```
2026-03-22T07:14:01Z INFO scim-provisioner tenant=acme POST /Users -> 409 {"detail":"externalId mismatch"}
2026-03-22T07:14:02Z WARN scim-provisioner reconcile retrying -> creating fallback user id=usr_shadow_9
2026-03-22T07:14:02Z ERROR kms-client decrypt failed: unsupported alg header: RSA-OAEP
```

carla: Sounds like the rewrap job didn't re-encrypt some legacy ciphertexts. We intentionally skip on decrypt errors to avoid data loss, which causes extId normalization to return null and the reconciler to assume missing identity.

devin: Two parts we need: remediation & prevention. For remediation: run a controlled backfill that attempts legacy-alg decrypt fallback, rewrap to the active alias, and then mark record reconciled. But avoid auto-merging RBAC until we can guarantee role copy.

ada: Agreed. For prevention: change scim-provisioner reconcile path: if POST -> 409, do not immediately create a shadow user. Instead perform multi-attribute match (email, displayName, group memberships) and if extId decrypt fails, enqueue to async repair queue and emit an audit event.

carla: For merge strategy: use a transactional merge that finds candidate pairs by exact email and then in a single DB tx moves role bindings, service principals, sessions, and deletes shadow row. Also emit a compact audit record: {tenant, old_extid, new_extid, merged_by=system, roles_migrated}. We'll store provenance in audit index for compliance.

devin: Also consider a short-lived compatibility mapping layer: when we rewrap extIds, insert alias map entries that allow downstream auth checks to accept either old or new extId for 72 hours. That eases live session handoffs.

kms-bot: Alert: key alias rotate idp-kms-main -> idp-kms-v2026 completed 2026-03-22T05:00:00Z. Rewrap job summary: started 2026-03-22T05:05:00Z ended 2026-03-22T05:54:42Z. failures=9 tenants.

prod-ops: Action items:
- ada: open customer tickets for the 2 orgs with visible duplicates and flag for communications (ETA 1h)
- devin: implement decrypt-fallback + safe-rewrap backfill that outputs dry-run report (ETA 5h)
- carla: implement transactional merge tool + dry-run mode and merger checklist for compliance (ETA 8h)
- infra: add alert to on-call if scim-provisioner creates >1 user for the same email within 15m (page eng-sre)

ada: One more thing: ensure audit records include the rewrap algorithm used and a checksum of pre/post extId to help auditors validate non-repudiation.

devin: Will include audit entries per merged account and a summary S3 report for compliance. Starting backfill now, will post results here when finished.

carla: I'll draft the merge dry-run report template and run against the 9 failed tenants. If any tenant has complex entitlements, we'll ask for manual sign-off before merging.

ada: Thanks all. Please keep this thread updated.
